verdict.rationale: Runpod documents an official, open-source CLI (runpodctl). It manages Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes and models, transfers files, and diagnoses issues, with concrete command examples such as `runpodctl pod create`. A separate Flash CLI handles project init and login, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in real-world use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Runpod CLI is an open source command-line tool for managing your Runpod resources from your local machine.
You can manage Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, and models, transfer files between your system and Runpod, diagnose issues, and view account information.
Create, start, stop, and terminate Pods using the Runpod console or CLI.
